instruction: A candid action photograph captures a martial arts sequence inside a karate dojo with yellow walls and red-and-blue floor mats. On the left, the woman in a black karate uniform with a red belt (R2) lunges forward, throwing a right-hand punch toward her opponent. On the right, the older man in a black karate uniform with white stripes (R1) stands in a defensive stance, blocking her incoming punch with his raised left forearm. Both wear protective safety glasses. The scene is illuminated by bright, even indoor overhead lighting, capturing the dynamic energy of the sparring session.
